battle_start.text: Ah, a battle! Do try to do something worth a verse.
Gather round, gather round, and mind the pointy end.
Every good song has a fight in the middle. Here's ours.

miss.text: Hm. We'll leave that out of the ballad.

crit.text: Oh, that's the second verse, right there!

kill.text: And here the singer pauses, out of respect.

ally_down.text: No, no, no. That's not how this one goes!

low_hp.text: Oh, this is the sad part, isn't it. I hate the sad part.

healed.text: Bless you. You'll get a chorus all your own.

victory.text: And they lived, and the song went on. For now.

camp.text: There's a last verse to the Song of the Seven. Nobody's sung it in two hundred years. I'll find it.
Sleep now, sleep now, the river is wide, and the fire keeps watch on the other side.
Songs don't burn. That's why I keep them.
Hum along if you know it. Nobody ever knows it.
You'll want to tell this one well, when you're old. I'd start practising.
